newsitem.title: USA: Wolverine sees Q1 profits below 1996 level.
newsitem.headline: Wolverine sees Q1 profits below 1996 level.

text.p: Wolverine Tube Inc said on Monday that it expects first quarter profits to be approximately 15 percent below the $10.3 million earned in last year's first quarter.
In last year's first quarter, the company posted earnings per share of $0.72 on sales of $179.4 million.
Analysts were expecting the company to earn $0.88 a share, according to First Call's consensus of securities analysts.
The company cited a slowdown in shipments due to lower levels of replacement of large commercial air conditioning units that use chlorofluorocarbons (CFC).
